content: Decompression as possible bottleneck: rustkmer gzip stays single-threaded per D-02 (bio reader sequential); if profiling shows decompression-bound, parallel decompression is a cheaper first win than table rewrite. Gerbil ~50% runtime I/O. KMC3 gzipped input ~44-53% faster than normalized in benchmark (parsing matters). Not yet profiled on rustkmer workload - flagged for mandated profiling phase. (Lower-confidence inference; specific flate2/zlib-ng parallel-decode gains not separately verified.)
